entities.summary: Devanahalli, also called "Devandahalli", "Dyaavandalli", Devanadoddi, and Devanapura, is a town in Bengaluru North District in the state of Karnataka in India. The town is located next to Nandi Hills and 40 kilometres (25 mi) to the north-east of Bengaluru.
